set.body:
Current plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, Full event-graph delivery. Owner approved proceeding 2026-11-16.

Scope: Reuse existing causal relation types and evidence/contexts. Proposals must retain their upstream claims and scope. No causation from adjacency, chronology or co-occurrence alone. Keep joint antecedents distinct from separately sufficient causes; unsupported semantic gaps require an ADR rather than lossy translation.

Engineering acceptance artifact: One causal witness artifact through public admission distinguishes an evidenced dependency, a joint cause, separate causes and an unresolved proposal; deleting an evidence or context guard produces a named compiled failure. Raw confidence never supplies factual authority or calibration.

Scope is one bounded synthetic account and its public path, not a whole-corpus extraction. Use repository reference-scope gates, relevant mutation/compile-refusal evidence and exact-SHA cold review. Graph-wide integration and fresh-data qualification remain on the existing E0 and human-evaluation tickets. Claim this slice, not a parent container.
set.title: [event-graph] Produce evidence-bound causal relations
